## Discovery & Translational Science

- **[Biotech]** **ABL Bio details preclinical profile of bispecific ADC ABL206** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42731893/)
  - ABL206 is a novel bispecific antibody-drug conjugate engineered to target both B7-H3 and ROR1 in solid tumors.

- **Spatial proteomics defines macrophage-CD8⁺ T cell injury niche in checkpoint inhibitor hepatotoxicity** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.18.26360744)
  - Single-cell imaging mass cytometry across 144 regions of interest in liver biopsies from patients with immune-mediated liver injury from checkpoint inhibitors (ILICI, n = 12) revealed histiocyte-rich granulomas composed of co-localized CD8⁺ T cells and macrophages.
  - Spatial permutation analysis identified integrated innate-adaptive cellular neighborhoods concentrating cleaved caspase-3 (apoptosis) and cleaved gasdermin D (pyroptosis) markers, providing a pathobiological distinction from autoimmune hepatitis.

- **Clonal haematopoiesis correlates with Alzheimer's-like cortical atrophy over six years** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.26362681)
  - Longitudinal evaluation of 1,091 older adults in the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 using methylation-based clonal haematopoiesis metrics (COMET pVAF and CIMS) demonstrated that clonal expansion over 6 years significantly correlated with progressive grey matter volume loss (standardized estimate = -0.176, p_adj = 0.030).
  - Cortical atrophy showed a left-lateralized pattern in medial temporal and parietal regions that significantly spatially corresponded to established Alzheimer's disease neurodegeneration signatures (r = 0.357, p = 0.003).

- **H&E spatial modeling enables counterfactual virtual radiotherapy trials in glioblastoma** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.26362768)
  - Patient-specific proliferation and diffusion parameters for a mechanistic reaction-diffusion model were inferred from single H&E biopsy cell-nucleus point patterns across 11 multicenter cohorts.
  - In silico radiotherapy trials in glioblastoma demonstrated that de-escalating fast-growing tumors to hypofractionation while dose-intensifying slow-growing tumors added 96.7 days of restricted mean progression-free survival over standard of care (permutation p < 0.001).

- **Circulating blood metabolomic Systemotype detects early-stage ovarian cancer** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.26362758)
  - Boosted decision tree models trained on untargeted metabolomic profiles from serum (n = 91) and plasma (n = 83) cohorts identified a shared 239-feature panel reflecting host and tumor systemic metabolic alterations.
  - Repeated cross-validation yielded 99.0% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity in serum, and 97.7% sensitivity and 99.7% specificity in plasma for early-stage disease identification.

- **Self-supervised Transformer standardizes disease prediction across partial proteomic panels** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.26362789)
  - A protein-token Transformer pretrained on 53,014 UK Biobank samples via masked-protein reconstruction generated fixed-dimensional representations without requiring missing-data imputation.
  - Across 144 diseases, models trained on full 2,920-protein panels retained a median AUC of 0.637 when tested on a 1,460-protein subset without refitting, which rose to 0.673 after retraining downstream linear predictors.

- **Multimodal explainable AI model improves NSCLC immunotherapy outcome prediction** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04488-2)
  - An international real-world study demonstrated that an explainable AI model integrating multimodal data outperformed established single biomarkers for predicting immunotherapy efficacy in non-small cell lung cancer.

- **Tumor cell-expressed OX40L enhances anti-PD-1 efficacy in NSCLC** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42731877/)
  - Preclinical findings demonstrate that tumor cell expression of OX40L enhances the therapeutic efficacy of PD-1/PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition in non-small cell lung cancer models.

- **Structural bioinformatics highlights deep learning limitations in CDR-H3 loop modeling** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42731718/)
  - Combined X-ray crystallography and bioinformatics analyses detail structural flexibility constraints in antibody CDR-H3 loops, identifying current boundaries of deep-learning-based structural prediction tools.

- **ECG-defined atrial cardiomyopathy refines cardiovascular mortality risk** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.09.26362666)
  - Analysis of 7,083 adults without baseline cardiovascular disease showed that ECG markers of atrial cardiomyopathy (P-wave duration ≥120 ms, abnormal axis, or terminal negativity in V1) stratified CV mortality risk, with the highest risk observed in adults with multiple cardiometabolic risk factors plus atrial cardiomyopathy (HR 2.25, 95% CI 1.75–2.87).

- **Single-cell aging clock scMLEAge quantifies biological age at single-cell resolution** [npj Aging](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00492-5)
  - Introduction of scMLEAge, a maximum-likelihood framework designed to estimate biological age trajectories from single-cell transcriptomic profiles.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Big Pharma]** **Afatinib neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy evaluated in Phase 2 head and neck cancer study** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42731876/)
  - The open-label Phase 2 neoCHANCE-2 study investigated neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy combined with EGFR inhibitor afatinib for locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

- **Somatosensory cortex cTBS fails to meet primary symptom endpoint in Phase 2 cervical dystonia trial** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.26362783)
  - A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled crossover trial in 13 patients with idiopathic cervical dystonia evaluated continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) applied to an S1 lesion network hub.
  - Active cTBS did not achieve a statistically significant reduction in Toronto Western Spasmodic Torticollis Scale scores relative to sham (p = 0.149), although wearable sensors measured a significant improvement in neck range of motion (p = 0.015).

- **Ciprofol demonstrates noninferiority to remimazolam for outpatient colonoscopy sedation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42731781/)
  - A randomized double-blind noninferiority trial evaluated the efficacy and safety of GABAA receptor modulator ciprofol vs remimazolam, each combined with alfentanil, for procedural sedation during outpatient colonoscopy.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Biotech]** **Summit Therapeutics readies Phase 3 Harmoni-2 overall survival readout** [X / @JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2098871371702968719)
  - Unconfirmed industry reporting indicates Summit Therapeutics is set to release overall survival data from the Phase 3 Harmoni-2 trial comparing ivonescimab (PD-1/VEGF bispecific) against pembrolizumab monotherapy in first-line PD-L1-positive non-small cell lung cancer.

## Business & Strategy

- **RA Capital leads biopharma venture activity with 30 financing rounds in 2026** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2098767715364176300)
  - Venture tracking data indicates RA Capital has participated in 30 biopharma financing rounds during 2026, surpassing investment volume from major peers including OrbiMed and ARCH Venture Partners.

- **ADC development exhibits target diversification alongside payload consolidation** [X / @paras_biotech](https://x.com/paras_biotech/status/2098863306115063969)
  - Industry analysis of the antibody-drug conjugate field points to expanding target exploration combined with narrowing consolidation around established payload chemistries.

## Public Health & Policy

- **Audit reveals uncorrected sample nonindependence in public prostate cancer studies** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.26362786)
  - A methodological audit across public repositories identified 101 nonindependent dataset pairs (97 featuring direct patient/specimen identity overlap).
  - Out of 108 examined publications, 8 papers performed analyses requiring independent samples across related datasets without reporting necessary overlap controls or adjustments.

- **Epic Cosmos EHR dataset utilized to build multi-million maternal-infant cohort** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.02.26354757)
  - Researchers leveraged the Epic Cosmos EHR dataset to establish a longitudinal cohort of 2,624,186 linked maternal-infant pregnancies from 2023–2024.
  - Applying longitudinal criteria from first-trimester care through 12-week infant follow-up narrowed the cohort to 509,148 pregnancies while maintaining representative demographic characteristics.

- **Germany launches hybrid effectiveness-implementation trial for cancer survivorship program** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.11.26362829)
  - The Hamburg Life After Cancer Program initiated a prospective hybrid type 2 study (n = 500 intervention, n = 250 external control) evaluating structured survivorship navigation, interdisciplinary care plans, and health-related quality of life outcomes.

**Worth watching:** Summit Therapeutics' upcoming Phase 3 Harmoni-2 overall survival readout comparing ivonescimab against pembrolizumab in first-line PD-L1-positive NSCLC.

- Biology & Health
    - [‘Fiber is not the Healthy Nutrient we’ve been Told!’](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uqf9jEPQKZQ) -- Physionic
        - Evaluates observational cohort studies (such as NIH-AARP, EPIC, PREDIMED, and JPHC) examining the relationships between dietary fiber intake and all-cause or cause-specific mortality.
        - Reviews evidence on soluble fibers, particularly psyllium (*Plantago ovata* husk), regarding their effects on glycemic control (fasting glucose and HbA1c in type 2 diabetes), ambulatory blood pressure, and lipid markers (LDL cholesterol and triglycerides).
        - Assesses the physiological impacts of resistant starch on skeletal muscle and adipose tissue insulin sensitivity, as well as its clinical efficacy on colorectal neoplasia in patients with Lynch syndrome.
        - Analyzes methodological criticisms and potential hypocrisy in how scientific evidence around dietary fiber is interpreted and communicated.
- Economics
    - [Why Germany Stopped Working](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ajH6YVhdOZU) -- Patrick Boyle
        - Examines Germany's economic stagnation following a suspended debt brake and an allocated €500 billion rebuilding fund that remains largely unspent due to institutional caution and consensus-driven bureaucratic paralysis.
        - Argues that external shocks—such as the loss of cheap Russian gas, rising Chinese competition, and American tariffs—do not fully explain internal execution failures in local infrastructure project spending.
        - Analyzes the structural transition challenges from traditional mechanical engineering to a software-driven economy, alongside the limitations of Germany's historical "Export World Champion" growth model.
        - Incorporates perspectives from economists Wolfgang Münchau, Michael Pettis, and Adam Tooze to contrast Germany's risk-averse policy framework with the US model of high-risk investment in technological moonshots.
- To watch
    - [How 0 Was Discovered](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u3Kp9f0KBAc) -- Abide By Reason
    - [How the world’s smartest robot brain works – Physical Intelligence Pi0 VLA](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/zfZE4hZ8efE) -- Welch Labs
